deployments_detail.value: Broader Miying platform: 270M medical images processed, 1.6M patients served, 210,000 clinical warnings issued

AI applied in Tencent's games business for game recommendations and in-app purchase / monetization optimization, credited with performance improvements across titles like VALORANT Mobile, Delta Force and Clash Royale. [Tencent (in-house ML/Hunyuan)]
deployments_detail.value: International gaming revenue $2.93B in Q3 2025 (+43% YoY)

deployments_detail.use: Hunyuan AI built into Tencent Docs generating first drafts from user topics and materials
